description: Photograph of hand-painted banners zip-tied to the chain-link fence of a highway overpass on a sunny day. Two white bed-sheet banners read 'PATRIOTS' and 'ARE IN CONTROL', with a third smaller sheet bearing a large Q symbol; a truck passes on the roadway below. The image is credited '(c) Veronica Wolski' and tagged #ThePeoplesBridge, the name Wolski used for the Kennedy Expressway pedestrian bridge in Chicago from which she regularly hung Q-related banners.
text: PATRIOTS. ARE IN CONTROL. Q. (c) Veronica Wolski. #ThePeoplesBridge
flags: Location identified as Wolski's Chicago 'People's Bridge' from the watermark/hashtag, not visible signage
